_comment: UNSW-NB15 Feature Schema – Phase 2. Generated by build_feature_schema.py. DO NOT edit manually.

excluded_columns.id: Non-predictive row identifier assigned sequentially. Leaks row ordering, not network semantics.
excluded_columns.label: Binary target variable – must never appear in X.
excluded_columns.attack_cat: Multi-class target / analysis field. Reserved for future multiclass detection. Must never appear in X.

notes.scaling: StandardScaler applied to numeric features only. Required for distance-based/linear models; tree-based models may skip. Pipeline handles this transparently.
notes.categorical_encoding: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', sparse_output=False) – safe for inference with unseen categories.
notes.infinite_values: np.inf / -np.inf replaced with np.nan before imputation.
notes.missing_values: SimpleImputer(strategy='median') for numeric, SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent') for categorical.
notes.train_test_split: Official UNSW-NB15 CSV split preserved. No random merging.
notes.validation_split: Stratified 80/20 from training CSV only (random_state=42). Test CSV reserved for final evaluation.
